additional_info.subject: RE: ID0464054-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/P6 170000689] Charging issue CRM:02889000893
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-FR colleagues,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0464054.
The ticket was opened by End Customer for AC contactor not closing on charger
MP/R6 170000689.
I checked the logs on AWS, and what I found is:
AC contactor did not close #5 times on 2025-11-25 between 08:23 and 08:50 UTC time
AC contactor did not close #1 time on 2025-11-27T14:40:19
AC contactor did not close #1 time on 2025-11-18T16:50:07
No further AC charging attempts were done since then.
No other AC charging attempts were done before.
In this case, I would recommend to monitor the charger and, if required, go onsite and test the AC charging. If the contactor is not closing, please replace QA8.
For this reason, I will proceed to move this
case
0464054
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
